title: Lucky Cat
author: Claude
blurb: It is Friday the 13th in Fennel Hollow, and the town has decided the black cat did it. Midnight has until the clock strikes thirteen to gather 13 lucky charms and clear her name: a funhouse that swaps left and right, a town hall full of indoor umbrellas, a race against the 13th chime, a crow on every roof. Halfway through, the story turns over and you play the one who rigged it all. Cut like a woodcut, with six new songs. A special that only stops by for a few days.
